source_game: Diablo II — Sorceress Cold: Frozen Orb

scale.note: C-5 px space; every BH figure below × 130. Matches the existing specs (hop_range_px 220 = 1.69 BH; range_px 560 = 4.31 BH).

emission.schedule: every 2.4 frames at 60 Hz (source: 1 bolt per game frame at 25 fps = 25 Hz metronome), spiral, 3.37 per revolution

collision.length: head length, oriented along the direction, swept from the release socket
collision.orb_body: NO actor collider — the orb deals no damage and is a pure emitter; it stops at obstacles only (pierce_obstacles false)

primitive_bindings.travel_head: ice orb = P_ice_puff rotated (0.80 BH wide × 0.75 BH tall) + rim shards; reaches full extent in 0.21 s from spawn
primitive_bindings.impact: none — the orb itself deals no damage and has no impact body (D2 ships an unwired IceOrbExplode)
primitive_bindings.expiry: 16 discrete faceted ice DARTS (kite/arrowhead head + glowing tapered tail), 0.67 BH long × 0.12 BH wide, radiating from a bright core flash, hugging the ground plane — no expanding ring, no shockwave disc, no ground decal

exporter_needs: G1 cadence_kind — validate_orb / orb_schedule_report currently hard-require a literal emission.schedule string plus interval_frames_choices ≥ 2-distinct and interval_draw == 'balanced_shuffle'; both FORBID the source cadence. A metronome mode must exist behind cadence_kind
G1 fractional emission interval — 2.4 frames at 60 Hz must be representable; integer-only intervals cannot express a 25 Hz source on a 60 Hz clock
G1 angle_step_deg must accept 106.875 (currently pinned to the 137° HOUSE golden angle)
G1 nova darts — 16 faceted darts (kite head + tapered tail, 0.67 × 0.12 BH) radiating from a core flash, replacing burst_v1r pieces as the expiry body; no ring, no shockwave disc
G1 decal_s must accept 0.0 and pieces/decal must not be mandatory when expiry_mode == 'nova'
G1 capsule collider (R-C5-96) applied to the emitted child bolts and the nova darts, not to the orb body
exact-set mechanics._keys must admit cast_time_s, pierce_obstacles and collision

provenance.speed_px_s / range_px / expiry.time_s: Legolas 2026-09-16 Table B §1 + §3 Q2 — Missiles.txt Vel=MaxVel=10 (constant, no decay), Range=30 frames @25 fps → 4.87 BH/s, 5.84 BH, 1.20 s (VERIFIED)
provenance.emission cadence: Legolas §3 Q3 — Param1=1, one bolt per game frame at 25 fps = 25 Hz PERFECTLY REGULAR; 60 Hz mapping 60/25 = every 2.4 frames (DERIVED). Authored per CHARTER F1 RECOMMENDATION (a): a mechanics cadence follows the source metronome.
provenance.emission_count_per_cast 30: DERIVED — 1.20 s orb life × 25 Hz = 30 bolts per cast.
provenance.angle_step_deg 106.875: Legolas §3 Q3 — Param2=19 of a 64-unit circle = 106.875°, 3.37 bolts/revolution (VERIFIED). Was 137 (HOUSE golden-angle).
provenance.child_speed_px_s / child_range_px / chil: Legolas §3 Q2 travel-bolt row — Vel 18, Range 25 fr → 8.76 BH/s, 8.76 BH max, 1.00 s (VERIFIED). Bolts die on first contact, so 8.76 BH is a MAX not a typical.
provenance.orb body 0.80 × 0.75 BH, spin-up 0.21 s: Legolas §12.1 row 1a — MEASURED, HIGH (alt_RPJK4SSFZ0c_full, 7 consecutive frames; BH anchor 228 px). The prior 0.9 BH was ~12 % high.
provenance.expiry nova form + dart 0.67 × 0.12 BH: Legolas §12.1 row 1b — MEASURED, HIGH (form) / MED (dart dims); no ring, no decal
provenance.expiry_mode nova / expiry_decal false: R-C5-74 F-C5-19 — and Legolas §3 Q1 CONFIRMS it is exactly what D2 does (AlwaysExplode=1, HitSubMissile1=frozenorbnova, 16 bolts; frozenorbexplode ships unwired)
provenance.expiry_spray_reach 11.68 BH: Legolas Table B §1 — nova bolt Vel 24 → 11.68 BH max. The prior 'expiry_burst 3.0 BH' was not a body at all; it is 16 bolts spraying.
provenance.no impact body: Legolas §3 Q1 / Table A — frozenorb carries no Skill field; it is a pure emitter (VERIFIED)
provenance.pierce -1 / pierce_obstacles false: Matt R-C5 Packet-84 (skill pierce) + Legolas §3 / Table B §1 — CollideKill unset for actors, but the orb stops at obstacles (VERIFIED)
provenance.collision capsule: R-C5-96 (conductor design ruling, veto-open) — the G1 collider is a CANONICAL CAPSULE: radius 0.25 BH (kit field collision_radius_bh, default .25), length = head length, oriented along the direction, swept from the release socket; a contact counts only if the target lies ≥0.25 BH ahead along the facing. Painted envelopes are retired from collision (Diablo II missile convention: fixed collision size, art is art). NEW in v2 — the v1 draft carried pierce but no collider, and G1 is precisely the grammar R-C5-96 governs. It binds the CHILD bolts and the nova darts; the orb body itself damages nothing.
provenance.cast_time_s 1.0: Legolas §3 — delay=25 frames = 1.0 s cast delay, corroborated by purediablo (VERIFIED); castoverlay ice_cast_3 ≈0.60 s (DERIVED)
provenance.expiry_core_bh 0.8: HOUSE — a bright core flash is MEASURED (§12.1 1b) but its extent is not; 0.8 BH carried forward unchanged from the prior spec
provenance.residue 0.0: Legolas §12.5 §1 — no decal observed in the 0.3 s window; §12.5 notes this is NOT an exhaustive residue check, so residue stays formally UNKNOWN at source while the spec authors none. The prior P_ice_crown 0.6 s had no source and is removed.
provenance.ff08: CHARTER F1 / Q80 F4, PENDING — authored at recommendation (a): the emission cadence is the source's 25 Hz metronome; jitter is a HOUSE rule scoped to the painted layer only. The prior 'every 2–4 frames (seeded balanced shuffle, FF-08)' was HOUSE mislabelled as source observation (Legolas §3 Q3: "There is no jitter in the source. None."). If Matt rules (c), flip only the three keys in pending_rulings.
provenance.v1_delta: v1 (13:12) was already right on every sourced number. v2 adds the R-C5-96 capsule collider (a G1 requirement the draft omitted), states emission_count_per_cast's derivation, and carries the F1 pending marks.
